question: What ritual action is performed in the maintenance wheel beginning from the east?
premises: The location is the maintenance wheel
The sequence begins from the east
The means are drops of nectar from the auspicious cup
inference: In the maintenance wheel, offerings are made from the east onward using drops of nectar from the auspicious cup.
uncertainties: The recipients of the drops are specified in the following verse
plain_english: But in the maintenance wheel, beginning from the east, one uses drops of nectar from the auspicious cup.
